description: Creates multiple field rules in a single request. Each item is validated independently; the response reports successes and failures per item.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Locale for localized response messages (for example: en, fr-FR, pseudo)

data.description: Response for bulk field rule create or update operations

succeeded.description: Rules that were successfully created or updated

failures.description: Rules that failed validation or persistence

items.description: Details of a single field rule that failed during a bulk operation

207.description: Partial success — some rules failed validation

400.description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or parameters that fail to meet validation requirements.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

items.description: Request to create a field rule (NAMING or FIELD_DEFAULTS)

rule_type.description: Rule type. Defaults to NAMING for backward compatibility.

asset_type_id.description: Asset type id (required for FIELD_DEFAULTS; null for NAMING).

fieldset_id.description: Fieldset id (required for FIELD_DEFAULTS). '-1' for Procore default fields; external configurable fieldset id for custom fields. Null for NAMING.

trigger_field.description: Trigger field. For NAMING: asset_code. For FIELD_DEFAULTS: the field this rule configures (e.g., custom_field_1234, trade_id).

rule_name.description: Display name for the rule. Optional: when omitted or blank, the backend auto-generates a scope-indicative name of the form '{rule_type}::{company_id}::{asset_type_id|NA}::{fieldset_id|NA}::{trigger...

definition.description: Structured rule definition. Shape depends on ruleType: FieldRuleDefinitionDTO for NAMING, FieldDefaultsDefinitionDTO for FIELD_DEFAULTS.
